Raj Thackeray Questions Actors Settling Abroad

MNS chief Raj Thackeray questioned why actors R. Madhavan and Vivek Oberoi have settled in Dubai. He posed this question in the context of the current political climate, implying that if the country is doing so well under Prime Minister Modi, there should be no reason for citizens to live abroad. Thackeray's remarks were directed at the actors' choices to reside in Dubai.
